# Massive Improvement Final Plan

> The Awtsmoos renews kindness and restraint as one harmony; Awtsmoos.com turns the surviving architecture into exact files, tests, and proof.

## Core source

- Create `createAwtsmoosLifecycleAuthorities.js` with semantic/compiler/constraint/cache/pipeline only.
- Create `createAwtsmoosLifecycle.js` using the existing `Awtsmoos` class.
- Rewrite `AwtsmoosAuthoringFacade.js` so Portal/world bind only when supplied.
- Rewrite `createAwtsmoosAuthorities.js` to extend lifecycle authorities with Portal/world.
- Rewrite universal API `index.js` to export the lifecycle factory additively.
- Inspect package metadata before deciding on a dedicated package subpath.

## Demo source

- Import direct lifecycle factory, never package-wide source barrel.
- Add lifecycle summary, pipeline renderer, unresolved-work renderer, query/keyboard navigation.
- Add application-ready dataset marker only after first successful lifecycle render.
- Preserve safe DOM construction and renderer-neutral SVG separation.

## Tests after source is complete

- lifecycle facade contract;
- lifecycle/full equivalence;
- default Modeling behavior;
- recursive import-graph exclusion;
- public demo route/import/readiness contract;
- existing universal/default/compiler/constraint/cache suites.

## Verification

Browser: ready marker, five scenarios, SVG, fifteen pipeline stages, cache hit, deferred work, mobile no-overflow, no severe logs, resource counts. Performance: bounded plan/compile/cache microbenchmark with environment disclosure. Then complete reread, DELTA, evidence ledger, exact staging, clean integration, push, two-phase production activation, and public browser proof.
